description:
From ISS-002. reporting.py:43,149 budgets raw bytes, hookio.py:168-185 measures escaped JSON and falls back to 900 bytes; advise() sends the text twice. Fix: budget the compact block by the escaped size via hookio.sends_whole (or clip the reason in _bounded_payload to fit) so the Full report line always survives, and claim principle explanations only for rows that were sent.

Acceptance: a 5-row block that escapes past 4096 bytes keeps the report path; a 2.2 KB PostToolUse advice is not cut to 900. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Fit block messages into the hook size limit without losing the report path
